title: Homemade Hamburger-Helper-Style Skillet
steps: Brown the ground beef in a large deep skillet, breaking it into small pieces. Check that ground beef reaches 160°F; drain excess fat.
Add broth, milk, pasta and seasonings. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook about 10–15 minutes, stirring often, until pasta is tender. Add a little water if needed.
Turn off the heat and stir in cheddar. Let it cool to a suitable eating temperature. Serve a familiar vegetable alongside.

title: Easy Ground-Beef Taco Night
allergens: Wheat in flour tortillas; milk if using cheese
steps: Cook ground beef in a skillet until it reaches 160°F, breaking it into small pieces. Drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning and water; simmer 3–5 minutes. Warm tortillas following package directions.
Put toppings in separate bowls and let each person build a taco or keep familiar components separate. Cool and adapt pieces to each child.

title: Slow-Cooker Salsa Chicken Tacos
time: 10 minutes prep · about 3–4 hours high / 6–7 hours low
allergens: Wheat in flour tortillas; check salsa labels
ingredients: 1½ lb fully thawed boneless chicken breast
Optional: shredded cheese or mashed avocado
steps: Place fully thawed chicken, salsa and broth in the slow cooker. Follow your appliance’s fill and liquid guidance; keep the lid closed while cooking.
Cook on high about 3–4 hours or low about 6–7 hours, checking the manufacturer’s guidance. Time varies: every piece of chicken must reach 165°F on a food thermometer.
Shred with two forks and mix into the cooking liquid. Serve in warmed tortillas or with rice, cooled and adapted for your child.

title: Easy Slow-Cooker Bean Chili
time: 10 minutes prep · 3–4 hours high / 6–7 hours low
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) kidney or pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Use canned beans, not uncooked dried kidney beans. Add all ingredients to the slow cooker and stir.
Follow appliance guidance; cook about 3–4 hours on high or 6–7 hours on low until hot throughout. Times vary by cooker.
Taste and adjust mild seasonings. Serve with rice, a baked potato, or bread. Cool before serving and adapt texture.

title: Ten-Minute Bean & Cheese Tacos
ingredients: Optional: mild salsa or mashed avocado
steps: Warm refried beans with the water in a saucepan, stirring until hot.
Warm tortillas following package directions. Fill with beans and cheese.
Offer toppings separately and let the filling cool before serving. This is an easy low-energy dinner; familiar components can stay separate.

title: Shortcut Chicken & Rice Bowls
allergens: Check rice, chicken and sauce labels
steps: Heat rice following package directions and cook frozen vegetables until tender.
Warm fully cooked chicken with the broth until it reaches 165°F; do not rely on rice cooking time to reheat it.
Serve components in bowls or separately with an optional familiar sauce. Cool and adapt sizes/textures before serving.
